title: VoxBlink-clean identities of FLAG_46 (Bengali / Bangladesh speakers removed before download; 15 175 speakers, 68 041 faces, 68 043 voices) + FaRL / CLIP-L / SimAM-ResNet100 encoders + VoxLingua107

modes.train: not run by default: collect stages run only when forced (configs/modes.json collect_kind_runs_only_when_forced) and every collected dataset is read from FF_DATA/01_collected (class 'collected' is in always_saved_classes). Re-collecting: force the whole collect closure in ONE run, with a fresh FF_WORK and FF_USE_SAVED=collected (README.md of 11_collect): FF_FORCE=c37_vox2,c53_vox2b,c46_voxblink,c45_frames_vox2,c_frames_index,c63_frames,c87_frames_bridge,c63v_audio_cache. Forcing this stage alone mixes its new rows with the old frames / audio cache (sampling is not deterministic). c46 does not fit in one 12 h Kaggle session (original: 2 sessions): run it outside Kaggle with VB_TIME_LIMIT_H=48, or in two sessions with VB_RESUME_FROM (README).

Session 1 is not recorded: 630 min is an estimate (it presumably stopped at VB_TIME_LIMIT_H = 10.5 h; its 473 shards at session 2's rate take about 10.4 h). Anonymous HF requests as in the run.

env_note: FLAG_LOCAL pinned to "0" so a value left in the caller's environment cannot switch the notebook into its local / smoke mode during a real run (smoke_env sets "1" under FF_SMOKE=1). FLAG_IN / FLAG_OUT would also bypass the runner's /kaggle paths if set by the caller and cannot be pinned here (a fixed value would be wrong): WP-A drops them from the inherited environment; never export them.

env_doc.VB_TIME_LIMIT_H: hours after which the shard loop stops (default 10.5 = Kaggle-safe). Outside Kaggle set it in the caller's environment, e.g. 48, to finish in one run (the runner passes the caller's environment; it is deliberately not set in env, which would override the caller).
env_doc.VB_RESUME_FROM: folder that CONTAINS the feats_vb/ of an earlier, time-limited session (resume patch). Unset = original behaviour.

patches.why: HF revision parameter (G27) for the 10 VoxBlink repos (annotations, progress map, 8 media parts); unset = original URLs (FF_PartURL.format returns exactly the original string when no revision is given)

stage_ipy.recipe:
release/flag2027_e2e/build_notebook.py stage_cells(): code cells of the original notebook in order, empty ones skipped, CRLF -> LF, cells whose title (first line, or the name in a leading print("[cell]/[boot] ..."), cut to 90 chars) matches a drop_cells regex removed, then every patch applied in list order (each must match exactly `count` times), then ''.join(cell.rstrip('
') + '
# <<<FF-CELL>>>
' for cell in cells), written UTF-8 with LF. No global patch is assumed.

insert_cells.source:
print("[cell] ff: completeness marker for the runner post_check", flush=True)
# [FF new cell] (CHANGES.md) The original run needed 2 Kaggle sessions: at VB_TIME_LIMIT_H the shard loop stops, the last original
# cell still writes a partial feats_vb/ and the notebook exits normally. This cell only reads that manifest and writes
# ff_completeness.json next to feats_vb/; stage.json post_checks makes complete == true fatal, so a partial output is never
# accepted as a finished collection (resume: README of 11_collect, VB_RESUME_FROM).
_ffm = json.loads((OUT / "feats_manifest.json").read_text())
_ffc = {"complete": int(_ffm["shards_done"]) == int(_ffm["shards_needed"]), "shards_done": int(_ffm["shards_done"]),
        "shards_needed": int(_ffm["shards_needed"]), "time_limit_h": TIME_LIMIT_H, "smoke": bool(SMOKE)}
(WORKDIR / "ff_completeness.json").write_text(json.dumps(_ffc, indent=1))
print("ff completeness:", _ffc, "" if _ffc["complete"] else "| NOT complete: move this output aside and run again with VB_RESUME_FROM",
      flush=True)
insert_cells.why: completeness marker for the fatal post_check (new code; starts with print("[cell] ..."))

smoke_prerequisite.why: smoke uses the notebook's own local mode (FLAG_LOCAL=1 skips the !pip cell; VB_SMOKE applies only with it), so the packages of the install cell must be present beforehand. No Docker needed.
